description: This file is responsible for generating and outputting a PDF version of a sales order within the vtiger CRM system. It initializes a PDF controller, loads a specific sales order record, retrieves its sequence number, and then outputs the corresponding PDF file for download.

classes.name: Vtiger_SalesOrderPDFController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling the creation and output of sales order PDFs.

methods.name: Vtiger_SalesOrderPDFController::__construct
methods.description: Constructor method initializing the PDF controller.

methods.name: Vtiger_SalesOrderPDFController::loadRecord
methods.description: Loads the sales order record data based on the provided record ID.
